newsitem.title: UK: Smithkline to market Vanguard's VML 251.
newsitem.headline: Smithkline to market Vanguard's VML 251.

text.p: Vanguard Medica Group Plc said on Monday that British drug giant SmithKline Beecham Plc would take up the worldwide marketing of Vanguard's anti-migraine drug, VML 251.
Vanguard said that results of clinical studies of VML 251 were most encouraging and showed that a distinctive profile was emerging for the new drug.
It added that on the basis of these results it planned to commence Phase III clinical trials in January 1997.
Vanguard said that it would receive a series of milestone payments and, upon commercialisation of the drug, a share of net operating receipts on a worldwide basis.
